headline: Argentina Treasury Official Demands Fiscal Balance and Prohibits Provincial Debt
summary: Argentine Treasury Secretary Carlos Guberman stated at UCEMA that subnational districts should resolve coparticipation among themselves and announced upcoming measures to prohibit provincial borrowing to enforce fiscal equilibrium.
why: Federal enforcement of subnational fiscal discipline and debt restrictions are critical components of macroeconomic stabilization programs.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Measures targeting provincial debt and coparticipation affect public sector fiscal accounts.
